attempted_claim: Let R^Λ_β be a cyclotomic quiver Hecke algebra for an arbitrary symmetrizable Cartan datum, dominant weight Λ, and β∈Q^+. Construct an explicit homogeneous (preferably monomial) basis of every corner e(ν)R^Λ_βe(ν′), indexed by categorical-crystal/path data, whose graded rank is compatible with the Hu–Shi dimension formula; in particular, give a uniform basis that specializes to the known tableau bases in type A, the minuscule finite-type bases, and the cyclotomic nilHecke bases.
decisive_failure: No uniform crystal-indexed monomial corner basis was constructed; affine and indefinite type B(Lambda) lack a finite tableau or string model, and KLR symmetrizer, Q-polynomial, and relation-driven truncation data are invisible to crystal/path data alone. The recovery computation covers only small cyclotomic nilHecke cases and proves no general no-go theorem.
